messages.content: Tell me about the CareerTalkLab project.
CareerTalkLab is John Serra’s language-learning platform project. See [CareerTalkLab](https://johnserra.com/projects/careertalklab).
What technologies does it use? Cite the project source.

requests.answer: CareerTalkLab is built with Next.js 16.1 (App Router), React 19, and TypeScript for the frontend. It uses Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn/ui for styling. The backend and authentication are handled by Supabase, which includes PostgreSQL, Auth, RLS, and Edge Functions. For content, it features a JSON-native Lesson Engine with over 8 interactive block types. AI feedback is powered by the Anthropic Claude API, and a Python-based pipeline is used for news ingestion. The project also incorporates a 4-tier automated testing suite for evaluation. [CareerTalkLab](https://johnserra.com/projects/careertalklab)
